The `develop` branch is where this work happens, and > things are still changing. The new documentation is not ready either; the > public docs and older guides mostly describe the previous version. > > You can already try the **unfinished new web app** locally at > [`http://localhost:5366/web-app/`](http://localhost:5366/web-app/) after setting > up Leon. More on that [below](#try-the-preview). ## A few words before 2.0 Hi, I'm Louis 👋 I started working on Leon in 2017 and released the first open-source version in 2019. I've been building it ever since. The idea is still the same. A personal AI assistant that gets to know you, remembers what matters to you, and helps you do things in your everyday life. **Humans at the center.** I want Leon to feel warm, cozy, and made with care. A place where you can create and take things at your own pace. There is more about [our philosophy](#philosophy) below, but first, here's how to try it. ## Try the preview If you are curious and comfortable running a project from source, you can explore the current work now. The desktop application is planned for the first 2.0 alpha. Until then, you can get an early look through the new web app. **It is not ready yet**, but it will give you a feel for where Leon is going. ### Set up Leon - macOS, Linux, or Windows - [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) >= 24 ```sh # Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/leon-ai/leon.git # Go to the project root cd leon # Install pnpm npm install --global pnpm@latest # Install dependencies pnpm install # Run Leon pnpm start ``` - Follow the setup prompts during `pnpm install`. - Open **[http://localhost:5366/web-app/](http://localhost:5366/web-app/)** for the new web app. The legacy interface is still at `/`. - Run `pnpm run check` to check your setup. - Downloads select supported Chinese mirrors when the downloading machine is in China. See [download sources and overrides](docs/reference/DOWNLOADS.md). - Use the [`master` branch](https://github.com/leon-ai/leon/tree/master) for the previous, pre-agentic version. ## A little look inside There is already plenty you can do with Leon. Try it with something you actually need help with and get a feel for it yourself. Aurora is Leon's component library, crafted to bring interactive charts, forms, and visual answers into your conversations. Vibes brings a little of the world outside into the app, with ambient scenes that follow the season, time of day, and weather. I asked Leon to “Show how to search sessions by recording a new tutorial”. Here’s the video it made. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/90d0880a-7e87-4063-a5bb-09d400da6bc0 A few previews from the work in progress, using sample conversations and setup screens. Click a screenshot for a closer look. | The new web app and Vibes | Task planning and execution | | --- | --- | | | | | Generative UI with trend charts | Generative UI with a bar chart | | --- | --- | | | | | Connecting your tools | A little help with coding | | --- | --- | | | | ## Built for personal AI A good model matters. So does everything around it. Leon has its own continuous agent loop, tool execution in isolated workers, progressive context management, and multi-layer memory. Here are a few of the choices behind it. - **Load what helps with the current task.** Context and tool guidance arrive progressively, down to the function Leon needs. Large tool outputs stay in artifacts, and older exchanges are compacted when needed to keep the working context focused. - **Give tools a proper home.** Tools declare their functions, settings, dependencies, and binaries. Their setup and execution follow defined code paths, so Leon can reuse a prepared capability the next time it needs it. - **Keep predictable workflows available.** Native skills follow explicit actions. Agent skills guide the agent loop through more flexible tasks. Both use the same tool system. - **Remember selectively.** Leon keeps temporary context, persistent facts and preferences, daily summaries, and recent discussion memory, isolated per profile. It retrieves relevant records when needed and can check original conversations for exact details. - **Act, observe, and recover.** The agent loop uses tool results to decide what to do next, checks outcomes, and can recover from failures. Independent tool calls can run concurrently in isolated workers. ### Understand the current project While the new documentation is being written, these generated context files are useful starting points. Check the relevant source for the details. - [`core/context/LEON.md`](./core/context/LEON.md) describes Leon's identity, behavior, and capabilities. - [`core/context/ARCHITECTURE.md`](./core/context/ARCHITECTURE.md) explains how the runtime, memory, tools, skills, and clients fit together. ## Personal AI, measured in practice We are building Leon to push the state of the art in personal AI. In our published comparisons, Leon leads the overall scores on selected WildClawBench and PinchBench tasks. Explore the results across different dimensions, along with the methods and limitations, at **[benchmarks.getleon.ai](https://benchmarks.getleon.ai/)**. ## Philosophy I love building personal AI. I've spent years on it, and I still have so many things I want to try. At the same time, I want us to enjoy the process. To understand what we build. To have a life outside our screens too. There is already enough noise around AI. You should be able to open Leon, feel at home, and take things at your own pace. I want 2.0 to feel warm, cozy, and made with care. - **Human craft still matters.** We use AI to help us build, learn, and improve the quality of our work. We also take the time to understand it, make decisions, and check the result. I want us to feel proud of what we put into Leon. Even with AI and coding agents helping us, I want us to keep having those little "yes, I did it!" moments. - **Personal AI should belong to you.** An assistant that knows you well will hold things that matter to you. That's a responsibility. Leon is open source, can run on your own machine, and supports local and remote models. You choose the models and services you connect it to. - **Open source is about people too.** Sharing code is part of it. So is helping someone get started, listening to feedback, explaining a decision, and learning from each other. That's the kind of project I want Leon to be. - **We have time to do things with care.** I want Leon to help you make room for your own ideas, your creativity, and the people around you. The same goes for how we build it. A thoughtful improvement, a good conversation, a useful fix. These things count. I wrote more about this in [Before Leon AI 2.0, I want to say this](https://blog.getleon.ai/before-leon-ai-2-0-i-want-to-say-this/). ## Let's build the next chapter together If you have been following Leon for years, thank you for sticking around. If you just found the project, welcome. I'm glad you're here. For a long time, I kept contributions limited because I was rewriting Leon and making frequent breaking changes. That's why the contributor count is still small. I wanted to get the foundations into a better place before asking people to invest their time. **More than 100 people have already expressed interest in actively contributing to Leon AI.** That means a lot to me. After the first 2.0 alpha release, we'll bring this community together and work on improving Leon. We'll share ideas, have community calls, build useful things, and help each other along the way. I want people to feel comfortable asking questions and sharing work they care about. A place where you know the people behind the usernames. Where we respect each other's time and opinions. Where it's nice to hang out, even when we're just figuring things out. You can already **[join our Discord](https://discord.gg/MNQqqKg)** to meet us and follow what's happening. And if you would like to take part in building Leon, fill out the **[Leon AI contributor interest form](https://forms.gle/6PCG2D5rYo1q8tKMA)**. It helps me get to know you and organize the next steps while we prepare the alpha. You can help with code, testing, documentation, design, translation, videos, or welcoming others. You don't need to be a developer to have something valuable to bring. For now, the core and interface are still moving quite a bit. I'm organizing contributions with that in mind, so we can give people a useful place to start and respect the time they offer. Really looking forward to seeing what we make together. ## 给中国朋友们的一点问候 大家好 👋 我是 Louis，一个住在深圳的法国人。很开心能通过 Leon 认识你们。欢迎来聊聊、分享想法，或者一起做点有意思的东西。希望这里也能让你们感到自在，就像和朋友在一起一样。 ## Follow along I share progress most regularly on **[X / @grenlouis](https://x.com/grenlouis)**. You can also follow along through the links below. - [Newsletter](https://leonai.substack.com/subscribe) - [Blog](https://blog.getleon.ai) - [Roadmap](http://roadmap.getleon.ai) - [GitHub issues](https://github.com/leon-ai/leon/issues) - [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCW6mk6j6nQUzFYY97r47emQ) For the longer backstory, read [the story behind Leon](https://blog.getleon.ai/the-story-behind-leon/). ## Author **Louis Grenard** ([@grenlouis](https://x.com/grenlouis)) ## Support Leon If you'd like to support the time and care that go into this project, you can [sponsor Leon](http://sponsor.getleon.ai). Leon is shared under the [MIT license](./LICENSE.md). ## Thanks | ![OpenAI logo.](./.github/assets/thanks/openai-logo-light-mode.svg?v=2#gh-light-mode-only)![OpenAI logo.](./.github/assets/thanks/openai-logo-dark-mode.svg?v=2#gh-dark-mode-only) | ![JetBrains logo.](./.github/assets/thanks/jetbrains-mono-black.svg?v=2#gh-light-mode-only)![JetBrains logo.](./.github/assets/thanks/jetbrains-mono-white.svg?v=2#gh-dark-mode-only) | ![MacStadium logo.](./.github/assets/thanks/macstadium-logo-light-mode.svg?v=2#gh-light-mode-only)![MacStadium logo.](./.github/assets/thanks/macstadium-logo-dark-mode.svg?v=2#gh-dark-mode-only) | | --- | --- | --- | | [openai.com/form/codex-for-oss](https://openai.com/form/codex-for-oss/) | [jb.gg/OpenSource](https://jb.gg/OpenSource) | [macstadium.com/company/opensource](https://macstadium.com/company/opensource) |

--- > [!IMPORTANT] > 我们正在准备首个 **Leon 2.0 alpha 版本**，届时会带来桌面应用。 > 这个版本还没有发布。目前的开发工作都在 `develop` 分支上，很多地方仍在变化。 > 新文档也还没有准备好；公开的文档站和旧指南大多介绍的是上一代版本。 > > 安装并启动 Leon 后，你已经可以在本地访问 > [`http://localhost:5366/web-app/`](http://localhost:5366/web-app/)， > 提前体验**尚未完成的新网页应用**。具体步骤在[下方](#体验预览版)。 ## 2.0 发布前，想说几句话 你好，我是 Louis 👋 我从 2017 年开始开发 Leon，在 2019 年发布了第一个开源版本。之后就一直做到了现在。 最初的想法一直没变。做一个会慢慢了解你、记住你在意的事，并在日常生活中帮上忙的个人 AI 助手。 **把人放在中心。** 我希望 Leon 是一个温暖、舒服、用心打磨的地方。你可以在这里创造，也可以按照自己的节奏慢慢来。后面会多聊一点[我们的理念](#理念)，不过先来看看怎么体验吧。 ## 体验预览版 如果你感兴趣，也熟悉从源码运行项目，现在就可以试试我们正在做的东西。 桌面应用计划随首个 2.0 alpha 版本一起发布。在那之前，你可以通过新网页应用先看一看。**它还没有准备好**，但已经能让你感受到 Leon 正在往哪个方向走。 ### 安装 Leon - macOS、Linux 或 Windows - [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) >= 24 ```sh # 克隆仓库 git clone https://github.com/leon-ai/leon.git # 进入项目根目录 cd leon # 安装 pnpm npm install --global pnpm@latest # 安装依赖 pnpm install # 启动 Leon pnpm start ``` - 在 `pnpm install` 期间按照提示完成配置。 - 打开 **[http://localhost:5366/web-app/](http://localhost:5366/web-app/)** 体验新网页应用。旧界面仍然可以在 `/` 访问。 - 运行 `pnpm run check` 检查安装情况。 - 如果你想使用还没有引入智能体机制的上一代版本，请切换到 [`master` 分支](https://github.com/leon-ai/leon/tree/master)。 ## 先看一看 Leon 已经有不少能帮上忙的地方了。找一件你确实需要帮助的事交给它，亲自试试，感受一下。 Aurora 是专为 Leon 用心打造的组件库，让交互图表、表单和可视化回答融入你的对话。 Vibes 把窗外的世界带进应用，让背景氛围随着季节、一天中的时段和天气变化。 我只是让 Leon「录制一个新教程，演示如何搜索会话」。下面就是它录好的视频。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/90d0880a-7e87-4063-a5bb-09d400da6bc0 下面是一些开发中的界面预览，使用了示例对话和配置页面。点击截图可以查看大图。 | 新网页应用和 Vibes | 任务规划与执行 | | --- | --- | | | | | 生成式界面与趋势图 | 生成式界面与柱状图 | | --- | --- | | | | | 连接你的工具 | 帮你写点代码 | | --- | --- | | | | ## 为个人 AI 而构建 一个好的模型很重要。围绕它构建的一切也同样重要。Leon 拥有自己的持续智能体循环、在隔离 worker 中执行的工具、渐进式上下文管理和多层记忆。下面是这套设计背后的一些选择。 - **按需加载当前任务需要的内容。** 上下文和工具指引会逐步加载，细化到 Leon 此刻需要调用的函数。较大的工具输出保存在结果文件中，较早的对话会在必要时压缩，让工作上下文保持相关和聚焦。 - **让工具有明确的职责和归属。** 每个工具都声明自己的函数、设置、依赖和二进制程序。准备和执行过程由明确的代码流程负责，这样下一次需要时，Leon 就可以复用已经准备好的能力。 - **保留可预测的工作流。** 原生技能按照明确的动作执行。智能体技能则引导智能体循环处理更灵活的任务。两者使用同一套工具系统。 - **有选择地记住有用的信息。** Leon 保存临时上下文、长期事实与偏好、每日摘要和近期对话记忆，不同配置档案（profile）之间彼此隔离。它会在需要时检索相关记录，也可以查阅原始对话来核实具体细节。 - **行动、观察，并从失败中恢复。** 智能体循环根据工具返回的结果决定下一步，检查实际结果，也能在遇到问题时调整并继续。彼此独立的工具调用可以在隔离的 worker 中并行执行。 ### 了解当前的项目 新文档还在编写中。这些自动生成的上下文文件可以帮助你了解项目，具体实现仍请以源码为准。 - [`core/context/LEON.md`](./core/context/LEON.md) 介绍 Leon 的身份、行为和能力。 - [`core/context/ARCHITECTURE.md`](./core/context/ARCHITECTURE.md) 介绍运行时、记忆、工具、技能和客户端如何协作。 ## 用实际表现衡量个人 AI 我们希望通过 Leon 推动个人 AI 的前沿发展。在已公开的对比中，Leon 在 WildClawBench 和 PinchBench 所选任务上的综合得分领先。 你可以在 **[benchmarks.getleon.ai](https://benchmarks.getleon.ai/)** 查看不同维度的结果，以及测试方法和局限。 ## 理念 我很喜欢做个人 AI。已经花了很多年，也还有好多想尝试的事。同时，我希望我们能享受这个过程。理解自己在做什么。也在屏幕之外，留一点时间给生活。 围绕 AI 的声音已经够嘈杂了。我希望你打开 Leon 时，能感到自在，像回到自己的空间一样，按照自己的节奏慢慢来。这也是我想带给 2.0 的感觉。温暖、舒服，而且能感受到背后的用心。 - **人的手艺依然重要。** 我们用 AI 帮助自己构建、学习，提高作品的质量。同时，也花时间理解、做决定、检查结果。我希望我们能为自己给 Leon 带来的东西感到自豪。即使用着 AI 和编程智能体，也依然能保留那些小小的“耶，我做到了！”的时刻。 - **你的个人 AI 应该属于你。** 一个很了解你的助手，会保存对你很重要的东西。这是一份责任。Leon 是开源的，可以运行在你自己的机器上，也支持本地和远程模型。使用哪些模型、连接哪些服务，都由你来选择。 - **开源也是人与人之间的事。** 分享代码是一部分。帮助别人上手、倾听反馈、解释一个决定、互相学习，也都是。我希望 Leon 成为这样的项目。 - **我们可以花时间，把事情做好。** 我希望 Leon 能为你的想法、创造力和身边的人腾出一点空间。我们构建 Leon 的方式也应该如此。一次认真思考后的改进，一场好的交流，一个实用的修复。这些都很重要。 我在[《在 Leon AI 2.0 之前，我想说几句话》](https://blog.getleon.ai/before-leon-ai-2-0-i-want-to-say-this/)里聊了更多。 ## 一起写下接下来的故事 如果你已经关注 Leon 很多年，谢谢你一直都在。如果你刚刚发现这个项目，欢迎。很高兴你能来到这里。 很长一段时间里，我限制了贡献的开放，因为我一直在重写 Leon，经常会做出不兼容的改动。这也是仓库目前贡献者数量还不多的原因。我想先把基础打得更好，再请大家投入自己的时间。 **已经有 100 多位朋友表达了想积极为 Leon AI 做贡献的意愿。** 这对我来说意义很大。 首个 2.0 alpha 版本发布后，我们会把这个社区聚起来，一起改进 Leon。交流想法，组织社区通话，做一些实用的东西，也互相帮帮忙。我希望大家在这里能自在地提问，分享自己用心做的作品。 一个能认识网名背后那些人的地方。尊重彼此的时间和想法。即使还没想好怎么做，也愿意过来坐坐、聊聊。 现在就可以**[加入我们的 Discord](https://discord.gg/MNQqqKg)**，认识大家，看看项目最近在做什么。 如果你也想参与构建 Leon，欢迎填写 **[Leon AI 贡献意向表](https://forms.gle/6PCG2D5rYo1q8tKMA)**。在准备 alpha 版本的这段时间里，这能帮助我了解你，也安排好接下来的事情。 代码、测试、文档、设计、翻译、视频，或是帮助新朋友熟悉项目，都可以。不需要是开发者，你也能带来有价值的东西。 目前，核心和界面仍然变化比较多。我会考虑到这一点来组织贡献，希望给大家找到合适的起点，也尊重每个人愿意付出的时间。 很期待看到我们会一起做出什么。 ## 给中国朋友们的一点问候 大家好 👋 我是 Louis，一个住在深圳的法国人。很开心能通过 Leon 认识你们。欢迎来聊聊、分享想法，或者一起做点有意思的东西。希望这里也能让你们感到自在，就像和朋友在一起一样。 ## 关注进展 我最常在 **[X / @grenlouis](https://x.com/grenlouis)** 分享开发进展。你也可以通过下面这些地方继续关注。 - [邮件订阅](https://leonai.substack.com/subscribe) - [博客](https://blog.getleon.ai) - [路线图](http://roadmap.getleon.ai) - [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/leon-ai/leon/issues) - [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCW6mk6j6nQUzFYY97r47emQ) 想了解项目更早的经历，可以看看 [Leon 背后的故事](https://blog.getleon.ai/the-story-behind-leon/)。 ## 作者 **Louis Grenard**（[@grenlouis](https://x.com/grenlouis)） ## 支持 Leon 如果你愿意支持投入这个项目的时间与心力，可以[赞助 Leon](http://sponsor.getleon.ai)。 Leon 以 [MIT 许可证](./LICENSE.md) 开源。 ## 感谢 | ![OpenAI 标志。](./.github/assets/thanks/openai-logo-light-mode.svg?v=2#gh-light-mode-only)![OpenAI 标志。](./.github/assets/thanks/openai-logo-dark-mode.svg?v=2#gh-dark-mode-only) | ![JetBrains 标志。](./.github/assets/thanks/jetbrains-mono-black.svg?v=2#gh-light-mode-only)![JetBrains 标志。](./.github/assets/thanks/jetbrains-mono-white.svg?v=2#gh-dark-mode-only) | ![MacStadium 标志。](./.github/assets/thanks/macstadium-logo-light-mode.svg?v=2#gh-light-mode-only)![MacStadium 标志。](./.github/assets/thanks/macstadium-logo-dark-mode.svg?v=2#gh-dark-mode-only) | | --- | --- | --- | | [openai.com/form/codex-for-oss](https://openai.com/form/codex-for-oss/) | [jb.gg/OpenSource](https://jb.gg/OpenSource) | [macstadium.com/company/opensource](https://macstadium.com/company/opensource) |
